tfa.extract: A Fresnel lens is a type of composite compact lens which reduces the amount of material required compared to a conventional lens by dividing the lens into a set of concentric annular sections.

onthisday.text: The first public library opened in a small town using an honor system for borrowing.

pages.extract: An honor system library lends books without guards or fines, relying on borrowers to return them. It removes enforcement costs but depends on community trust.
